entities.title: C# library
entities.summary: Utv for .NET 8: the C# implementation of UTV, library version 0.3.0 (NuGet package id Utv), reading utv/1.0, writing utv-result/1.0 results and the utv-text/1 text form.
entities.purpose: Holds one .NET solution, Utv.sln: the library in src/Utv, its tests and examples in tests/, and the C# engine-interface sketch in docs/. README.md is what a person reads first; CHANGELOG.md is the record of the library's versions.
boundaries: Reads the shared material in schema/ and conformance/ in place; never copies it.
Claims no conformance profile yet, and ships no registries (no tzdb, leap-second table or other calendars).
Versioned on its own with SemVer, tagged csharp/vX.Y.Z (VERSIONING.md).
